assemblyAssets.scope: All original manufacturer leaves, formal post and custom adapter preserved. Added post/table screws and dowels are BOM and verification envelopes, not detailed assembly leaves.

limitations: Fixed-body internal actuator travel, ruby contact slip, springs/flexures, locknut movement, physical torque and preload are not simulated. This verifies modeled moving carrier/load clearance against the new adapter over a conservative ball-referenced angular square.
Included rubber-tip holder clamp screws are absent in supplier CAD; centered nominal cube has0.05mm seating gap per side and clamp-down may lower center0.05mm. Optical center62.5 is nominal.
Minimum0.62mm-class internal web is geometrically closed; machining robustness, tolerances and strength require manufacturing review, not production-ready certification.

notes: 厂家实体未缩放/删体；当前协议缺少独立P/S透反率与相位，保持unsupported，不执行opticalAssembly。先用4×M6×12固定裸柱，再安装转接件P1、厂家架M1、固定架及玻璃；厂家附薄头螺钉用1余1，不重复采购。厂家架定位销Ø2×5插架1.5／转接件3.5；柱接口销Ø2×8另计。名义总装中的外加标准螺钉/销列BOM及检验包络，不冒称完整螺钉叶件CAD。内部调节实CAD审核另附；实物行程、标定与生产工艺未验。  H12.5 B4-R2：普通H12.5柱底脚4 mm，其余普通柱保持各自规格；完整STEP已换柱回读，总高、孔位和全部器件姿态保持；未实物试装。
